title: Generate a contract with the intended app environment
goal: Select a build-time application environment with OpenApiGenerationEnvironment when endpoint inclusion or document transformers depend on configuration.

selectionNotes: OpenApiGenerationEnvironment is supported by the .NET 11 ApiDescription.Server build assets. It selects the generation process environment, not the deployed runtime environment. Build generation runs application startup with a mock server; isolate network/resource side effects and rebuild when changing the environment.

packageAssets: Newer: Microsoft.AspNetCore.OpenApi and Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server 11.0.0-rc.2.26504.105, Microsoft.OpenApi 3.10.2, net11.0. Older comparison: OpenApi 10.0.13, ApiDescription.Server 10.0.0, Microsoft.OpenApi 2.12.2, net10.0. Locked resolved graphs are saved independently. NSwag.ConsoleCore 14.7.1/NJsonSchema 11.6.1 verifies the selected OpenAPI 3.0 client document; it is not a server or Playbook dependency.
providers: Built-in ASP.NET Core OpenAPI generator, ApiDescription.Server build tool, Kestrel and System.Text.Json; NSwag only for the representative generated consumer. No database/cloud provider.
platforms: ASP.NET Core supported server platforms; actual managed execution on Windows x64.
renderingModes: Server HTTP APIs; no Blazor rendering mode or browser required.
prerequisites: Restore pinned packages and framework packs before execution. The installed Playbook guidance itself is complete offline and needs no account/key.
Use the canonical separate SDK pins for the older/newer examples. These verification pins are distinct from consumer release-family requirements.
constraints: OpenApiGenerationEnvironment is supported by the .NET 11 ApiDescription.Server build assets. It selects the generation process environment, not the deployed runtime environment. Build generation runs application startup with a mock server; isolate network/resource side effects and rebuild when changing the environment.

The examples use separate net10.0/C# 14 and net11.0/C# 15 SDK/package baselines. The historical .NET 10 comparison is not an older-target route for the .NET 11 APIs. No .NET 9 foundation or extra edition is introduced.

The generated client check covers the ordinary status endpoint from an explicit 3.0 document. It establishes neither OpenAPI 3.2 parsing nor generated SSE consumption. The hand-written stream check reads actual SSE frames. No experimental API opt-in is used.
stabilityLimitations: Stable framework capability, prepared with .NET 11 RC2 artifacts under ADR 0004. GA source/package/runtime reconciliation remains separate.
